sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- This upper comes with a dogtags tattoo on the left arm with the writings "BATTLE SCARRED 2015-2024" and "VETERAN EDGE OF DARKNESS", referencing the period in which the limited "Edge of Darkness" game edition was sold.

- During development, the design of the tattoo was a rendition of the "Join, or Die" political cartoon.

- The original name of this tactical clothing was "USEC Red Preppers".
